page0.text:
...
Wait.
They're going to take the Einzbern Grail...?
"...!"

page1.text:
I run.
I don't care about Zouken's cackling.
He's just watching me from a safe location, anyway.
No, never mind that old bastard's rambling...

page2.text:
"Hurry, Shirou Emiya!
Sakura has already been Darkened. If she catches Illyasviel, she will devour her without mercy...!"
"...!"

page3.text:
I run as fast as I can. I don't care if my legs give out.
"Be safe, Illya!!!"
It takes twenty minutes to get home from the mansion at a full sprint.
I run back to Illya as fast as I can, glaring up at the overcast sky.
